threads.title: Mossfield - new survival server, whitelist open

posts.author: rookery
posts.body:
halloween update is out so i finally set up the server i keep talking about.

survival, no plugins except the basics, whitelist so we dont get griefed into the ground. its on copperline's builder plan so it should actually stay up this time. first server i ran was a hamachi thing called bracken, rip, it died when my laptop did.

post your mc name and ill add you. rules are on the signs at spawn, read them pls

posts.author: cairn
posts.body: cairn. i'll do farms if nobody else wants to. i'm up early anyway

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: added. 5am cairn wtf

posts.author: cairn
posts.body: bakery. 4am start. you get used to it

posts.author: finchline
posts.body: finchline pls! i want to do a rail line from spawn to wherever cairn's farms end up

posts.author: juni_lantern
posts.body: hi! juni_lantern, halifax. I mostly build and take way too many screenshots. is anyone near the water yet? I want the coast

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: coast is yours. east side past the gravel beach

posts.author: patchcord
posts.body: patchcord, manchester. heard there's a mumble going? I can host one, I've got a box doing nothing

posts.author: kitbag
posts.body: hi im kit. theo is my brother he said i could ask here. i have a dog called biscuit. i will not grief

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: added. rule 4 applies to you especially

posts.author: finchline
posts.body:
first bit is down from spawn. its a booster line for now (two carts, you push one into the other) because there is no other way to make them go uphill. please dont take the spare carts at the boosters, thats what makes it work

south branch is just a sketch, dont 'finish' it

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: boosters are cursed but ok

posts.author: juni_lantern
posts.body:
plans for the coast build: a little house and a lighthouse on the point. glass top. I want to make the tower flash like the one at home, no idea how yet, redstone people help

no roof on the top. it's a light, it needs to see

posts.author: finchline
posts.body: torch clock maybe? torches dont really make light flash tho. ill think

posts.author: patchcord
posts.body: mumble is up. address in your PMs. I record sessions sometimes for the laughs, I'll say when. password for the channel is the song. you'll work it out

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: patch your password is a SONG??

posts.author: patchcord
posts.body: it's a good song

posts.author: rookery
posts.body:
beta 1.2 is out so we have coloured wool now. essentials /i takes 35:N where N is the colour:

0 white, 1 orange, 2 magenta, 3 light blue, 4 yellow, 5 lime, 6 pink, 7 gray, 8 light gray, 9 cyan, 10 purple, 11 blue, 12 brown, 13 green, 14 red, 15 black

dye is NOT the same numbers, dont ask me why, notch hates us

posts.author: rookery
posts.body:
1.3 lets you pick the seed so we're starting fresh. old map is backed up if you want anything. seed's my first server lol

spawn is in the same kind of spot, forest by the water. beds work now so no more dying to skip the night

posts.author: juni_lantern
posts.body: noooo my coast. ok. new coast. same plan

posts.author: cairn
posts.body: fine. fields again

threads.title: Chicago storage issue - some game servers affected

posts.author: Theo [Copperline]
posts.body:
Hi all,

One of our Chicago storage arrays had a problem overnight and a small number of game servers are affected.  If your world looks wrong, please open a ticket.  We're on it.

Cheers, T

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: mossfield is half gone. like chunks just missing. backup slot is the same broken copy

posts.author: Theo [Copperline]
posts.body:
No worries at all!  Your world will be back by tomorrow.  Iona's looking at it now.

Cheers, T

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: its not back by tomorrow theo

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: is anyone else seeing this. there are people walking around who arent online

posts.author: cairn
posts.body: there's another me at the farm. doing my morning loop. i'm at the storehouse

posts.author: juni_lantern
posts.body: my tower has a roof. I didn't build a roof. I'm watching it put glass on

posts.author: kitbag
posts.body: was that you guys walking around? i saw rook by the cake and then rook was gone

posts.author: patchcord
posts.body: recording mumble from now. everyone talk normal

posts.author: i_bell
posts.body: I stopped the restore process at 06:17 CDT. Nobody log in until I say. Please do not try to undo anything it built, the region files are fragile.

posts.author: cairn
posts.body: i only trust the uneven copy. storehouse labels are wrong in the clean backup. whoever restores it: do not make the chests tidy just because the sheet says they should be

posts.author: rookery
posts.body: its moving again. theo did you turn it back on

No worries at all!  Your world will be back by tomorrow.  Iona is on it.
